scope: Six scratch operational DBs and real seven-service Gateway flow; bound test sessions use live Identity, Directory read only; no live account/clinical data mutation

checks.name: Assigned source doctor reads the real uploaded PDF and creates a real draft/Lab order in one synthetic visit
Pending receiver has no clinical/profile/file access; repeated pending request is stable and wrong receiver/ADMIN cannot accept
Concurrent acceptance keeps original authorship and immediately revokes former doctor clinical/profile/Lab/PDF read/write with their still-active token
Receiver reads exactly the same uploaded bytes and inherited Lab/draft without signing another doctor draft; unrelated patient remains denied
Revoking medical coordination invalidates a pending exceptional handover without changing current responsibility
Authorized return handover, draft/order cancellation and finalization finish through normal commands in scratch DBs
